structure_review.rationale: Figure 1b shows the ICG chromophore with a seven-methine bridge, an iminium terminus and two sulfobutyl sulfonates. Restoring the missing bridge carbon and terminal bond order removes the artificial radical in the inherited graph.
structure_review.limitations: Assistant visual source review and graph checks, not independent expert certification. SI corroboration remains incomplete.
